title: Gupta et al. (2026): Soil Hydraulic Supply Shapes Maize Drought Responses Across Soil Textures (data and code)
description: Data, code and Supporting Information for the article "Soil Hydraulic Supply Shapes Maize Drought Responses Across Soil Textures" by Gupta et al., New Phytologist (2026). Six maize (Zea mays L.) genotypes were grown in silt loam and sandy loam, with drought imposed from establishment or after shoot development. The repository contains the soil hydraulic properties (HYPROP), the plant and soil measurements of both campaigns, and the Python scripts that derive transpiration downregulation thresholds on the scales of soil water content, matric potential, unsaturated hydraulic conductivity K(h) and matric flux potential, and that produce the statistics, figures and tables of the article. See README for the layout and how to run the scripts.
